name: Rule grant partially narrowed by same-policy Deny -> downgraded to conditionally-reachable
note: Allow ec2:TerminateInstances + ec2:DeleteVolume on one instance; a same-policy Deny removes only ec2:TerminateInstances. The DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION grant is not fully blocked (DeleteVolume survives) but is narrowed, so graph.js downgrades the can-destroy edge from confirmed-by-context to conditionally-reachable rather than overstating a clean grant.
